title: Diagnostics Upload Blocked by Web Security Gateway
description: Detects diagnostics package uploads that were answered by a security appliance's HTML block page instead of the Autopilot Monitor backend. A forward proxy / secure web gateway (SWG) with SSL inspection is intercepting the upload endpoint, so exactly the sessions where diagnostics matter most (OnFailure uploads) are the ones losing them.
author: Autopilot Monitor
explanation:
The agent collected a diagnostics package but the upload was answered with an **HTML block page from a web security gateway** instead of a response from the Autopilot Monitor backend — the event message names the product that served the page. A forward proxy / SWG with SSL inspection is intercepting HTTPS traffic from the enrollment network and blocking the upload endpoint.

The consequence is quietly painful: diagnostics upload is typically configured **OnFailure**, so the sessions that fail — the ones where the IME logs and diagnostics ZIP would explain the root cause — are exactly the sessions whose evidence never arrives. Enrollment telemetry itself may still flow (the agent often starts before the gateway's client enforcement does, or other endpoints are treated differently), which makes the gap easy to miss until a failure needs investigating.

Note this rule only fires when the blocking page carries a recognizable security-product marker. A plain HTML error page without one usually means a stale or stopped endpoint instead — that is a different problem.

remediation.title: Exempt the upload endpoint in the web gateway
steps: Identify the product from the block-page title quoted in this event's message (e.g. a Skyhigh/McAfee Web Gateway notification page)
In that gateway, add the Autopilot Monitor API host shown in the event message to the SSL-inspection bypass AND the URL allowlist for the enrollment network segment
Enrollment traffic often originates from a dedicated provisioning VLAN or from devices without the proxy client yet — make sure the exemption applies to that segment, not only to managed clients
If the gateway enforces per-user policy, remember ESP-phase traffic runs as SYSTEM/device before any user signs in — the exemption must cover unauthenticated device traffic

remediation.title: Verify the fix
steps: Re-run an enrollment (or wait for the next failed one) and confirm a diagnostics package appears on the session in the portal
Optionally set diagnostics upload to Always temporarily to validate the path without needing a failure
